analysis_summary: Strategic investment discussion with C Worldwide strategist Morten Springborg on the geopolitical shift from unipolar to multipolar world. Key themes include European defense industry investments (favoring Saab, Rheinmetall), need for Western manufacturing rebuild, electrification opportunities, gold as reserve asset, and expected underperformance of US equities relative to Europe and emerging markets over next 5-10 years. Focus on quality capital goods companies and the intelligent tangible world theme.
